verify.subject: Confirm your email for FinTrack
verify.intro: Open the link to confirm your email and finish signing up.
verify.outro: The link works for one hour. If you did not sign up for FinTrack, ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your FinTrack password
reset.intro: Open the link to set a new password.
reset.outro: The link works for one hour. If you did not ask to reset the password, ignore this email: the password stays the same.
